# Dwayne Johnson Brings His Whole Family to Live-Action ‘Moana’ Premiere In Los Angeles

[**Dwayne Johnson**](https://www.justjared.com/tags/dwayne-johnson/) made it a big family affair at the premiere of his new movie, the live-action _[**Moana**](https://www.justjared.com/tags/moana/)_!
The 54-year-old actor and executive producer hit the blue carpet on Tuesday evening (July 7) at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles, and was joined by his wife **Lauren Hashian** and their two daughters, **Jasmine** , 10, and **Tiana** , 8, as well as his mom **Ata** , ex-wife and producing partner **Dany Garcia** with her husband **Dave Rienzi** , and **Dwayne** and **Dany** ‘s daughter **Simone Johnson** with her girlfriend **Tatyanna Dumas**. 
[![The cast and crew of Moana at the Los Angeles premiere](https://www.justjared.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/celebs-attending-moana-premiere-in-los-angeles-16.jpg)35](https://www.justjared.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/celebs-attending-moana-premiere-in-los-angeles-16.jpg "Open gallery of 35 images.")
Also in attendance were **Dwayne** ‘s co-stars (left to right) **John Tui** (Chief Tui), **Frankie Adams** (Sina, Moana’s mother), **Catherine Laga’aia** (Moana), **Emma Puahi-Shapazian** (4-year-old Moana), **Amaya Masoli** (8-year-old Moana), and **Rena Owen** (Gramma Tala), as well as director **Thomas Kail** and producer/songwriter **Lin-Manuel Miranda**. 
Original _Moana_ star and live-action executive producer **Auli’i Cravalho** hit the blue carpet as well, and she was seen posing with **Catherine**!
[![Auli'i Cravalho attends live-action Moana premiere in Los Angeles](https://www.justjared.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/celebs-attending-moana-premiere-in-los-angeles-02.jpg)35](https://www.justjared.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/celebs-attending-moana-premiere-in-los-angeles-02.jpg "Open gallery of 35 images.") [![Catherine Laga'aia and Auli'i Cravalho attend live-action Moana premiere in Los Angeles](https://www.justjared.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/celebs-attending-moana-premiere-in-los-angeles-28.jpg)35](https://www.justjared.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/celebs-attending-moana-premiere-in-los-angeles-28.jpg "Open gallery of 35 images.")
The live-action reimagining of the hit animated Disney movie follows Moana (**Laga?aia**), who “answers the Ocean’s call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui (**Johnson**) on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.” 
_Moana_ is set to hit theaters THIS Friday (July 10). [Watch the final trailer here!](https://www.justjared.com/2026/06/10/final-moana-trailer-unveiled-jemaine-clement-confirmed-to-reprise-voice-role-watch-now/)
If you missed it, **Dwayne** , **Catherine** , **Auli’i** and **Thomas** [promoted the movie in London](https://www.justjared.com/2026/06/30/moana-stars-dwayne-johnson-aulii-cravalho-reunite-at-moana-experience-launch-in-the-u-k/) last week.
**Dwayne** also just confirmed that [a third animated _Moana_ movie](https://www.justjared.com/2026/07/02/dwayne-johnson-reveals-moana-3-is-in-the-works/) is currently in the works!
